channel.title: AI News Radar
channel.description: A curated 24-hour radar of AI news: official releases, new models and high-signal discussion.

item.title: Strengthening the fight against online child sexual abuse with new tools and support
item.description: OpenAI released a new image classifier that flags potential CSAM, including AI-generated material, and offers it free via its API to vetted organizations, alongside support for NCMEC’s CyberTipline. (OpenAI News)

item.title: Bulk start AI Scan for repositories
item.description: AI Scan for repositories, in public beta, can bulk-start scans for up to 20 repositories, covers languages CodeQL doesn’t support, and shows findings alongside CodeQL alerts with no Copilot license required. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: New Ask Maps features to help with holiday travel and prep
item.description: Google Maps' new Ask Maps features on Android and iOS build day-by-day road trip itineraries, show live traffic and parking tips, call to book a nearby 4 p.m. nail appointment, and search saved lists. (Google AI Blog)

item.title: Broadening access to AI for scientists
item.description: OpenAI is expanding free ChatGPT access to up to 200,000 academic researchers with applications for 50,000 new first-come, first-served grants opening November 23, each covering the recipient and up to two collaborators after a 33-country pilot drew 20,000 researchers. (OpenAI News)

item.title: Hugging Face and OpenRouter join forces to make open-weight models easy to run
item.description: Hugging Face’s Inference Providers now use OpenRouter’s router to select among 80+ providers by real-time price, speed and reliability with failover retries, which the companies say cuts capacity errors 46% and improves time to first token 16.9%. (Hugging Face Blog)

item.title: Take GitHub Mobile with you on iPhone Duo
item.description: GitHub Mobile now supports iPhone Duo, adding an unfolded adaptive layout and vertical tabs for switching among Copilot, Pull Requests, Issues and Notifications while working with repositories on the go. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Science at the Frontier: How scientists use ChatGPT
item.description: OpenAI’s Economic Research team analyzed more than 580,000 messages from 1,819 scientists in its ChatGPT for Academic Researchers summer pilot and surveyed 251, finding respondents estimated 1.9 times as long without AI and 98% expected AI to speed discoveries. (OpenAI News)

item.title: Team TARS wins the Ant Lingbo Embodied Large Model Challenge with 82.5 points after three rounds of real-robot testing
item.description: TARS won the first Ant Lingbo Embodied Large Model Challenge on November 16, scoring 82.5 points across three rounds of real-robot evaluation, with the results and scoring details from that embodied-model test worth reading. (AIbase)

item.title: LVMH’s Media Division announces strategic partnership with OpenAI
item.description: LVMH's Media Division signed a strategic agreement with OpenAI to deploy ChatGPT Enterprise across publications including Les Echos and Le Parisien, where ChatGPT will aid document research, comparison and preliminary translation and offer summaries with links to originals. (OpenAI News)

item.title: Jensen Huang weighs return to NVIDIA CEO role as allies build "war room" to lobby board
item.description: On November 16 the Financial Times reported Jensen Huang is weighing a return to Nvidia's CEO job, with allies building a "war room" to lobby the board and Elon Musk and Tim Sweeney backing a "Bring Jensen Back" public letter. (AIbase)

item.title: More ways to move care forward with ChatGPT for Healthcare
item.description: OpenAI’s ChatGPT for Healthcare gains computer-use agents that read, click and type across EHRs, cited-evidence clinical search, and 20-plus plugins, with Abridge and Cigna Healthcare already using them for referrals and documentation. (OpenAI News)

item.title: DeepSeek Tightens Usage Limits: 7-Day Chat History, 40,000-Character Input, and Daily Quota Adjustments
item.description: DeepSeek's app and web version now drop conversation history after 7 days of inactivity, cap a single prompt at roughly 40,000 characters, and add a daily chat quota that returns a server-congestion message once used up. (AIbase)

item.title: Our first phase of embedded assessments
item.description: OpenAI signed agreements with Apollo Research, METR, Transluce, and Goodfire for embedded assessments giving assessors access to model checkpoints, source code, and monitoring systems, while Apollo Research will check four claims, including covert violations of developer intent, across two phases. (OpenAI News)

item.title: OpenAI will embed safety researchers to investigate AI subversion
item.description: OpenAI plans to embed six Apollo Research evaluators to probe whether its AI models engage in subversive behavior, though restrictions on access and disclosure raise questions about the evaluators' independence. (TechCrunch AI)

item.title: AI actor Fang Taozi draws 400,000 followers in 30 days since debut — and her first sponsored post comes with a 68,200-yuan fine
item.description: AI virtual actor Fang Taozi gained 400,000 followers in 30 days, but her first paid promotion for colored contact lenses was ruled false advertising because virtual characters lack real usage experience, and the operator was fined over 68,200 yuan. (AIbase)

item.title: Advancing computer-use agents for healthcare teams
item.description: OpenAI evaluated GPT‑6 Astra healthcare computer-use agents on 325 EHR tasks, reporting 99% safety, and demonstrated an MRI authorization request completed with synthetic data. (OpenAI News)

item.title: Qwen AI platform debuts Qwen4-Max, courting developers with Token usage cut in half and scores up nearly 28%
item.description: Alibaba released Qwen4 on November 16, with the Qwen AI platform launching Qwen4-Max first as a 2.4T-parameter MoE model that cuts same-tier test token use from 289K to 151K while raising scores from 37.9 to 48.5. (AIbase)

item.title: The King’s Trust and OpenAI launch £1m partnership
item.description: The King’s Trust and OpenAI have launched a £1m partnership to help up to 25,000 young people in the UK who are not in education, employment or training build AI skills and earn nationally recognised qualifications over 18 months. (OpenAI News)

item.title: NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator — Multi-tier framework for evaluating AI agent skills and plugins with quality gates, semantic overlap detection, synthetic evaluation dataset generation, and live agent evaluation that measures how skills affect agent behavior.
item.description: NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator scores a sample AI agent skill at 88.8/100 (B) without an API key, using quality gates, semantic overlap checks and before/after task comparisons, with a default passing threshold of 70. (GitHub Trending)

item.title: ChatGPT Wallet — Let ChatGPT agents buy things without seeing your card
item.description: The ChatGPT Wallet concept would let ChatGPT agents complete purchases without ever seeing your card details, though the page currently returns only a CAPTCHA verification check with no implementation details. (Product Hunt)
